title: Sudas
exam_points: Dasarajna (das rajaon ka) yuddh Parushni (Ravi) nadi ke kinare hua; Rigveda ke 7th mandal mein varnit.
Sudas Bharata kabile ka raja tha; purohit Vashishtha the, Vishwamitra virodhi paksh mein.
Sudas ne 10 rajaon ke sangh ko haraya.

mcqs.q: Dasarajna yuddh kis nadi ke kinare hua?
